content.context: CS ERP has 8 IoT schema tables (iot_container_gps_trackings, iot_vessel_positions, etc.) with CRUD but NO real-time tracking UI, NO AIS polling, NO GPS webhook endpoints, and NO map visualization. The ports table has lat/lng columns. Need to build end-to-end live tracking for vessels, containers, and ports on an interactive map.
content.decision: 4-phase implementation: (1) Map UI + port/vessel/container plotting from existing DB data, (2) AIS vessel polling from external API providers, (3) Container event tracking via webhook endpoints, (4) GPS device data ingestion via webhook endpoints.
rationale: Phase 1 delivers immediate visual value using existing data — zero external dependencies
Phase 2 adds AIS (legally broadcast vessel positions) via configurable API provider (VesselFinder/Datalastic/MarineTraffic) — tenant-configurable API key
Phase 3 enables terminal/EDI milestone events to update container last-known-location — maps events to port coordinates
Phase 4 adds real GPS device data ingestion for reefer/high-value containers — direct lat/lng from hardware devices
Leaflet + OpenStreetMap chosen over Google Maps — no API key cost, OSS, works with CSP
alternatives_rejected: Google Maps — requires paid API key, complex billing, unnecessary for B2B shipping ERP
Mapbox — good but paid; OSM sufficient for port/vessel/container dots
react-leaflet — has React 19 compatibility issues; direct Leaflet with useRef is more reliable
WebSocket real-time push — over-engineering for Phase 1; polling + refresh button sufficient initially

technical_details.map_library: leaflet (direct, not react-leaflet) — dynamic import with ssr:false
technical_details.leaflet_css: Loaded via CDN link tag in layout or imported in component

api_endpoints.map_data: GET /api/v1/tracking/map-data — returns ports + vessels + containers with lat/lng
api_endpoints.ais_poll: POST /api/v1/tracking/ais-poll — polls AIS provider, writes to iot_vessel_positions
api_endpoints.container_event: POST /api/v1/tracking/container-event — webhook for terminal/EDI milestone events
api_endpoints.gps_ingest: POST /api/v1/tracking/gps-ingest — webhook for GPS device data
